notes: Feature-track metric landmarks and multi-view proxy depth now update a continuous information-form 3D Gaussian map. Full 3x3 centre covariance drives Mahalanobis association and Bayesian fusion, a separate surface covariance preserves splat extent, correlated/replayed camera evidence cannot over-shrink uncertainty, and the spatial hash is acceleration only so multiple hypotheses may coexist in one cell. Deep fills gaps after local track-based calibration; TSDF/mesh is derived from confirmed Gaussians rather than being the persistent map.
